blocks.title: White rust leaf spectra 2025-26: step-by-step analysis manual
blocks.subtitle: Follow the boxes in order and tick each one. Every step gives the command, what the script does, what you must see before you continue and the files it writes – from the raw ASD files to the delivered models.
lines: Animesh Panda · Ph.D. (Agricultural Physics) · ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute, New Delhi
Companion to: Detailed methodology with references (grouped 70:30 design). Step codes in brackets (A5, C2, D5 …) refer to that document.
Scripts: folder wrguide (13 step scripts, 5 library files, run_all.bat). Tested end to end on the 2025-26 files.

items: **Do the steps in order.** Each step reads the files written by the steps before it. The master checklist (next page) shows the order.
**Tick every box.** A step is finished only when every box under "Check before you continue" is ticked. If a check fails, stop and fix it before the next step.
**Run a quick test first.** Set WR_FAST=1 and run all steps once with small settings (about 20 minutes). It shows that the software and files are in order. Never use quick-test results in the thesis.
**Then run the full analysis** with WR_FAST unset. Keep its out folder unchanged as the record of the analysis.
**Change settings only in config.py,** never inside a step script, and write every change in your notebook.

**Three rules protect the result:** (1) never change the test plots (config.TEST_PLOTS); (2) never use the Objective 1 feature lists (Step 5) as model inputs – the models use Step 6 only; (3) do not go back and change features or settings after you have seen the test metrics of Step 9.

lines: """STEP 2 (A5): quality control -> one checked leaf table.
(1) join the plot plan  (2) remove L4 spectra  (3) remove duplicated spectra  (4) splice correction at the detector joins  (5) checks and labels."""
import os, numpy as np, pandas as pd
M = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(C.OUT, '01_meta_raw.csv')); X = np.load(os.path.join(C.OUT, '01_X_raw.npy')); wl = np.load(os.path.join(C.OUT, '01_wl.npy'))
M['block'] = M['plot'].map(C.BLOCK); M['timing'] = M['plot'].map(lambda p: C.LAYOUT[p][:2]); lay_var = M['plot'].map(lambda p: C.LAYOUT[p][2:])
bad = (lay_var != M.variety); rep.append('plots whose variety differs from the plan: %d' % M.loc[bad, 'plot'].nunique()); assert not bad.any(), M.loc[bad, ['date', 'plot', 'variety']]
drop = ~M.leaf.isin(C.LEAF_POSITIONS); rep.append('spectra with a leaf position other than L3/L5/LL removed: %d %s' % (drop.sum(), M.loc[drop, 'leaf'].value_counts().to_dict()))
# (3) duplicated spectra (identical values at every wavelength) - keep the first copy
rep.append('duplicated spectra removed: %d (dates %s, plots %s)' % (dup.sum(), M.loc[dup, 'date'].unique().tolist(), sorted(M.loc[dup, 'plot'].unique().tolist())))
X, before, after, applied = splice_correct(X, wl)
for J in C.SPLICE_JOINS: rep.append('join %d/%d nm: median excess jump %.5f -> %.5f (%s)' % (J, J + 1, before[J], after[J], 'corrected' if applied[J] else 'no step, unchanged'))
M['grade'] = M.score.astype(int); assert set(M.grade) <= set(C.GRADES), 'unexpected grade'
M['sowing'] = M.timing.map(C.SOWING); M['DAS'] = (pd.to_datetime(M.date) - pd.to_datetime(M.sowing)).dt.days; M['stage_code'] = M.stage.map(C.STAGE_CODE)
assert M.stage_code.notna().all(), 'unknown growth stage label'; assert not np.isnan(X).any()
rep.append('leaves after quality control: %d; reflectance range %.3f-%.3f' % (len(M), X.min(), X.max()))
open(os.path.join(C.OUT, '02_qc_report.txt'), 'w').write('\n'.join(rep)); print('\n'.join('CHECK: ' + r for r in rep))

blocks.text: Commands to type in the Anaconda Prompt (inside the scripts folder):

items: D1–D3: mean ± SD spectra by grade and difference from grade 0; correlation of every band with the grade; strata table.
